# FR-12 – Step 2: Identify equivalence classes for each input & output

Input: the variables and decisions (D1–D8) in `FR-12_1_variables.md`. Method: lecture S04 *Domain Testing*, step 2.

**Authorship:** the classes were generated by **ChatGPT** from the step 1 file, the lecture guideline and an example step 2 file. They were then **reviewed by the tester and restructured with Claude**: duplicates merged, untestable classes removed, V/I values normalised, and outputs linked to class IDs. No new test ideas were added in the restructuring. The full list of changes is in *Review changes* at the end.

## Guidelines applied (S04, slides 8–11)

| Condition kind | Rule | Example in this feature |
|---|---|---|
| **Set** | 1 valid class per element (if handled differently) + 1 invalid class | Endpoint group, HTTP method, public endpoints, stored token |
| **Must be** | 1 valid class + 1 invalid class | Header present, `Bearer` scheme, token unmodified, role = admin, no `role` in profile update |
| **Range (date/time)** | 1 valid class + invalid class(es) | Token age (recorded only, D4) |
| **Split** | Split a class when its members may not be handled the same way | Scheme variants, malformed vs altered token, deleted vs demoted owner |

**Legend:** V = valid, I = invalid, TBD = expected result recorded at execution. "Tester decision" = the spec is silent; the expected result was chosen by the tester (see the decision log).
For IN_09 (endpoint) and IN_10 (method), every listed value is a legitimate request (**V**); which combinations are protected is checked through the outputs and in step 3.
Representative values are **not** chosen here; that is step 3.

ChatGPT's original draft had 67 classes: 8 were removed and 2 pairs merged (67 − 8 − 2 = 57); see below.

## Decision log
D1–D8 are carried over from step 1. New in step 2:

| # | Question | Decision |
|---|---|---|
| D9 | Status code when the token's owner was deleted or demoted (D5) | **Deleted: 404** (tester decision: the user resource no longer exists). **Demoted: 403**, following D3, because the account exists but is no longer admin. |
| D10 | Classes no black-box tester can reach | **Removed** (see review changes); recorded in the AI gap analysis. |

## Review changes (ChatGPT draft → this file)

| ChatGPT class(es) | Change | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| All | V / I column normalised to V, I or TBD | Draft used phrases ("I for admin access", "V / TBD", "Protected; admin token required"); EC_27–42 had no V/I value. |
| All outputs | "Triggered by" rewritten as class IDs | Needed for the step 3 coverage check. |
| EC_03 | **Removed** | An account with a missing or unknown role cannot be created through the app. |
| EC_04, EC_05 | Merged into new EC_03 (correct credentials) | Duplicated the admin/user split already in IN_01. |
| EC_06 | Renamed EC_04, narrowed to "wrong password" | EC_08 (unknown account) is its own class. |
| EC_17, EC_18 | Split cleanly into EC_15 (not a token) and EC_16 (altered token) | "Forged or modified" in EC_17 already contained EC_18. |
| EC_21 | **Removed** | Only the server issues valid tokens, and it only issues `admin` or `user`; unreachable black-box. |
| EC_22 | Now EC_19, V instead of "V / TBD" | A fresh token is simply valid; only the expired case is TBD. |
| EC_27–32 | Methods removed from endpoint classes | Methods belong to IN_10; mixing them duplicated EC_38–40. |
| EC_31, EC_32 | Merged into EC_28 (`/api/coupons`, all methods) | Same path; D1 and D2 both apply to it. |
| EC_33, EC_34, EC_41 | **Removed** | Duplicated the public endpoints in IN_11. |
| EC_36 | **Removed** | "Other endpoints not in scope": not testable and outside FR-12. |
| EC_37–40 | Simplified to one class per method (EC_30–33) | Endpoint-dependence is handled by IN_09 and the outputs. |
| EC_46 | **Removed** | An expected outcome, not a value of IN_11; covered by EC_47 and EC_48. |
| EC_52 | **Removed** (merged into EC_39) | "No token stored" = "not logged in". |
| EC_53, EC_54 | Changed from V to **I** (now EC_44, EC_45) | Sending `role` is the input the system must ignore; under the must-be rule, "no role field" (EC_43) is the valid class. |
